24
Asɔfokuo ahodoɔ aduonu nnan no
1 # 1 Be 23.6; 6.3 Na Aaron mma no deɛ, wɔn mu nkyekyɛmu nie: Aaron mma ne: Nadab ne Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar. 2#Lew 10.1, 2 Na Nadab ne Abihu dii wɔn agya anim wuwui a wɔnni mma. Na Eleasa ne Itamar bɛdii asɔfoɔ. 3#2 Be 8.14 Na Dawid buu wɔn mu: Sadok a ɔfiri Eleasa mma mu, ne Ahimelek a ɔfiri Itamar mma mu, sɛdeɛ wɔn adwumayɛ dibea teɛ wɔ wɔn som no mu. 4Na wɔhunuu Eleasa mma mu mmarima no mu atitire bebree sene Itamar mma mu, na wɔbuu wɔn mu: Eleasa mma nyaa mpanimfie atitire dunsia, na Itamar mma, wɔn mpanimfie so, nwɔtwe. 5Na wɔtoo wɔn so ntonto tetee wɔn mu, yeinom ne yeinom, na kronkronbea mmapɔmma ne Nyankopɔn mmapɔmma no firi Eleasa mma ne Itamar mma mu. 6#1 Be 18.16 Na Netanel ba Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Semaia a ɔfiri Lewifoɔ mu no twerɛɛ ne nyinaa wɔ ɔhene ne mmapɔmma ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar ba Ahimelek ne asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ agyanom mu atitire no anim, wɔyii agya fie baako maa Eleasa ansa na wɔreyi baako nso ama Itamar.
7Na ntonto no bɔɔ Yehoiarib kane. Deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu yɛɛ Yedaia deɛ, 8Harim deɛ tɔɔ so mmiɛnsa, Seorim deɛ, nnan, 9Malkia deɛ, nnum, Miyamin deɛ, nsia. 10#Luk 1.5 Hakos deɛ, nson, Abia deɛ, nwɔtwe, 11Yesua#24.11 YESUA: Sei na wɔtwerɛ Yosua wɔ Aramaik a ɛyɛ Hebri kasa no fa bi no mu. deɛ, nkron, Sekania deɛ, edu, 12Eliasib deɛ, dubaako, Yakim deɛ, dummienu, 13Hupa deɛ, dummiɛnsa, Yesebeab deɛ, dunan, 14Bilga deɛ, dunum, Imer deɛ, dunsia, 15Hesir deɛ, dunson, Hapises deɛ, dunwɔtwe, 16Petahia deɛ, dunkron, Yeheskel deɛ, aduonu, 17Yakin deɛ, aduonu baako, Gamul deɛ, aduonu mmienu, 18Delaia deɛ, aduonu mmiɛnsa, Maasia deɛ, aduonu nnan. 19Yei ne wɔn adwumayɛ dibea, sɛdeɛ wɔn som no teɛ, sɛ wɔnhyɛne AWURADE fie sɛ wɔn atorɔmudeɛ a ɛnam wɔn agya Aaron so baeɛ no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.
Lewi mma mu atitire
20Na Lewi mma a aka no deɛ: Amram mma mu: Subael; Subael mma mu: Yehdeia. 21#1 Be 23.17-23; 26.25 Rehabia deɛ, Rehabia mma mu: Yisia ne panin. 22Yisharfoɔ mu: Selomot. Selomot mma mu: Yahat. 23Na Hebron mma ne: Yeria, otitire Amaria di hɔ, Yahasiel tɔ so mmiɛnsa, Yekameam tɔ so nnan. 24Usiel mma: Mika. Mika mma mu: Samir. 25Mika nua Yisia. Yisia mma mu: Sakaria. 26Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi; ne ba Yaasia mma: Beno. 27Merari mma a wɔyɛ ne ba Yaasia deɛ ne: Beno, Soham, Sakur ne Ibri. 28Mahli deɛ: Eleasa, na ɔno deɛ, ɔnni mma. 29Kis deɛ, Kis mma: Yerahmeel. 30Na Musi mma ne: Mahli, Eder ne Yerimot. Yeinom ne Lewifoɔ mma sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ. 31#1 Be 25.8 Na yeinom nso twee ntonto sɛ wɔn nuanom Aaron mma no ara, Ɔhene Dawid, Sadok, Ahimelek, asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ agyanom atitire no anim, agyanom mu atitire, sɛ ne nua kumaa ara.

Na Aaron mma no deɛ, wɔn mu nkyekyɛmu nie: Aaron mma ne: Nadab ne Abihu, Eleasa ne Itamar. Na Nadab ne Abihu dii wɔn agya anim wuwui a wɔnni mma. Na Eleasa ne Itamar bɛdii asɔfoɔ. Na Dawid buu wɔn mu: Sadok a ɔfiri Eleasa mma mu, ne Ahimelek a ɔfiri Itamar mma mu, sɛdeɛ wɔn adwumayɛ dibea teɛ wɔ wɔn som no mu. Na wɔhunuu Eleasa mma mu mmarima no mu atitire bebree sene Itamar mma mu, na wɔbuu wɔn mu: Eleasa mma nyaa mpanimfie atitire dunsia, na Itamar mma, wɔn mpanimfie so, nwɔtwe. Na wɔtoo wɔn so ntonto tetee wɔn mu, yeinom ne yeinom, na kronkronbea mmapɔmma ne Nyankopɔn mmapɔmma no firi Eleasa mma ne Itamar mma mu. Na Netanel ba Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Semaia a ɔfiri Lewifoɔ mu no twerɛɛ ne nyinaa wɔ ɔhene ne mmapɔmma ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Sadok ne Abiatar ba Ahimelek ne asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ agyanom mu atitire no anim, wɔyii agya fie baako maa Eleasa ansa na wɔreyi baako nso ama Itamar.
Na ntonto no bɔɔ Yehoiarib kane. Deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu yɛɛ Yedaia deɛ, Harim deɛ tɔɔ so mmiɛnsa, Seorim deɛ, nnan, Malkia deɛ, nnum, Miyamin deɛ, nsia. Hakos deɛ, nson, Abia deɛ, nwɔtwe, Yesua deɛ, nkron, Sekania deɛ, edu, Eliasib deɛ, dubaako, Yakim deɛ, dummienu, Hupa deɛ, dummiɛnsa, Yesebeab deɛ, dunan, Bilga deɛ, dunum, Imer deɛ, dunsia, Hesir deɛ, dunson, Hapises deɛ, dunwɔtwe, Petahia deɛ, dunkron, Yeheskel deɛ, aduonu, Yakin deɛ, aduonu baako, Gamul deɛ, aduonu mmienu, Delaia deɛ, aduonu mmiɛnsa, Maasia deɛ, aduonu nnan. Yei ne wɔn adwumayɛ dibea, sɛdeɛ wɔn som no teɛ, sɛ wɔnhyɛne AWURADE fie sɛ wɔn atorɔmudeɛ a ɛnam wɔn agya Aaron so baeɛ no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no.

Na Lewi mma a aka no deɛ: Amram mma mu: Subael; Subael mma mu: Yehdeia. Rehabia deɛ, Rehabia mma mu: Yisia ne panin. Yisharfoɔ mu: Selomot. Selomot mma mu: Yahat. Na Hebron mma ne: Yeria, otitire Amaria di hɔ, Yahasiel tɔ so mmiɛnsa, Yekameam tɔ so nnan. Usiel mma: Mika. Mika mma mu: Samir. Mika nua Yisia. Yisia mma mu: Sakaria. Merari mma ne: Mahli ne Musi; ne ba Yaasia mma: Beno. Merari mma a wɔyɛ ne ba Yaasia deɛ ne: Beno, Soham, Sakur ne Ibri. Mahli deɛ: Eleasa, na ɔno deɛ, ɔnni mma. Kis deɛ, Kis mma: Yerahmeel. Na Musi mma ne: Mahli, Eder ne Yerimot. Yeinom ne Lewifoɔ mma sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ. Na yeinom nso twee ntonto sɛ wɔn nuanom Aaron mma no ara, Ɔhene Dawid, Sadok, Ahimelek, asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ agyanom atitire no anim, agyanom mu atitire, sɛ ne nua kumaa ara.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
